what: ## DCC1. To codegen-rq-mir-constcheck (`hir-ty-mir` `const_check`): the `Deref` impl's `Target` of a deref coercion What: `ConstCheckKind::NonConstDerefCoercion` gets `deref_target: Option`, the `type Target` of the `Deref` impl the call resolves to. That is rustc's `call_kind` `deref_target_span`: `Instance::try_resolve(deref, args)`, its parent an impl, and `specialization_graph::assoc_def(impl, deref_target)` final, else `None` (`compiler/rustc_trait_selection/src/error_reporting/traits/call_kind.rs`). `callee` is `Deref::deref` itself, so blaze-diagnostics can't find the impl without solving. Why: rustc's `NonConstDerefCoercion` has the span note "deref defined here" at it. The lowering writes "attempting to deref into `{target}`" and, once this lands, the span note at `def_range_view` of the alias's source.
